column1: # Maps each compound ENCODE output_type / DataType / FeatureType term to its ONGA
# faceted form: output_type OR feature_type (the atomic base) + strand +
# read_multiplicity + filter_status + normalization. This is the lossless
# round-trip bridge between the compound ENCODE terms and ONGA's faceted
# The base lives in `output_type` when the compound term is a DataType, and in
# `feature_type` (added operation #12) when it is a FeatureType term. Exactly one
# of those two columns is populated per row; the other is empty.
# Axes factored out: strand, read_multiplicity, filter_status, normalization,
# redacted) stay baked into the output_type base.
# out of compound DataType/FeatureType terms (`haplotype-specific alignments`,
# `phased variant calls`, `phased mapping`). It is a CONTENT facet (the second
# intrinsic-content facet after strand), homed on the `haplotype_resolution`
# slot of TrackInterpretation -> HaplotypeResolution. Absent means
# haplotype-collapsed / not phase-resolved. The parental-origin axis
# sense of "allele-specific" are deliberately NOT values of this axis.
# reference-build sex axis (male / female) out of compound DataType terms
# (`male/female genome reference|index`). It is homed on the `build_sex` slot of
# the ReferenceGenome descriptor schema (the 5th schema). The male/female here
# qualifies the REFERENCE assembly used (which sex chromosomes it contains), NOT
# the biological sample's sex (a biospecimen property delegated to PATO). Absent
# The `derivation` column (added operation #14) factors the measured-vs-model
# axis (observed / predicted) out of compound profile / feature terms
# (derivation -> Derivation on TrackProvenance). `control` is NOT a derivation
# value (it denotes an experimental role or normalization reference), so
# control terms are not decomposed onto this axis. CHAINED RECONCILIATION
# (operation #14): nine existing rows that pointed at the now-removed compound
# bases `observed/predicted signal profile`, `predicted bias profile`, and
# `observed control profile` were re-pointed to the new stripped bases
# `signal profile` / `bias profile` / `control profile` with derivation set to
# observed/predicted; their other facet columns (strand, normalization) are
# preserved, making them genuine multi-axis compounds.
# The `normalization` column (added operation #11) factors the scaling axis
# (raw / depth_normalized / percentage_normalized) out of compound signal terms.
# SYNONYM MERGE: three ENCODE terms collapse many-to-one onto signal +
# `raw normalized signal` (raw signal after library-size normalization = depth-
# normalized). The map records all three rows so the ENCODE->ONGA direction stays
# well-defined; the ONGA->ENCODE direction is intentionally AMBIGUOUS for these
# (a deliberate non-1:1 collapse approved by the curator).
# base_exists=no flags atomic base terms that do NOT yet exist as standalone
# DataType/FeatureType terms; the matching removal step must add these when it
# removes the compound terms. (base_exists is recorded as of the operation that
# added each row; the strand/read_multiplicity rows reflect operation #7 state,
# the filter rows reflect operation #9 state, the normalization rows reflect
# operation #11 state, the FeatureType strand/filter rows reflect operation #12
# DataType enum is NOT modified by this step.
